description: Source code for Tiny SXW2RML, a report engine converting OpenOffice (.sxw) templates into RML using XML and XSLT transformations, including classes for handling SXW archive contents and XML DOM manipulation.

classes.name: DomApiGeneral
classes.description: Utility class providing general DOM and XML handling functions.

classes.name: DomApi
classes.description: Class providing DOM API for SXW XML files, including style and length normalization.

classes.name: PyOpenOffice
classes.description: Main class for reading SXW files, extracting content and images, and normalizing XML content.

methods.name: sxw2rml
methods.description: Converts an SXW file to RML using an XSLT stylesheet, embedding images as base64.

methods.name: PyOpenOffice.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the SXW processing object with output path and image saving option.

methods.name: PyOpenOffice.oo_read
methods.description: Reads content and styles XML from SXW ZIP archive, extracts images if needed.

methods.name: PyOpenOffice.oo_replace
methods.description: Performs regex-based replacements on SXW content XML.

methods.name: PyOpenOffice.unpackNormalize
methods.description: Reads, replaces, and normalizes SXW content XML, returning processed XML string.
